homeDescription: The stain and the smell, not just the surface.

whatsIncluded.label: Find the source
whatsIncluded.description: I use a moisture meter to find exactly where the accidents soaked in, including spots you can't see.

whatsIncluded.label: Enzyme treatment
whatsIncluded.description: An enzyme cleaner breaks down the odor at its source instead of just covering it up.

whatsIncluded.label: Deep flush & extraction
whatsIncluded.description: Hot-water extraction flushes the treated area and pulls the mess back out of the carpet and pad.

whatsIncluded.label: An honest look
whatsIncluded.description: If it's soaked into the subfloor, I'll tell you straight what it'll take, no guessing.

faq.q: Will the smell really be gone?
faq.a: For surface and pad-level odor, almost always. The enzyme breaks it down instead of masking it. If it's reached the subfloor I'll be honest about what's possible.

faq.q: Can you get the stain out too?
faq.a: Most pet stains lift well. Old, set-in stains may leave a faint mark. I'll tell you what to expect before I start.

faq.q: Is it safe for pets and kids?
faq.a: Yes. The enzyme treatments I use are safe around pets and children once the area's dry.

faq.q: Do I have to replace the pad?
faq.a: Usually not. Replacing pad or subfloor is a last resort for severe cases; most odor clears with treatment and extraction.
